item.title: Portage SSM pharmacy closure, announced two weeks before, leaves families, workers in lurch
item.description: The Dean Clinic pharmacy in Portage is closing on Feb. 13, with SSM Health providing two weeks notice to customers and employees on Jan. 30.

item.title: Walmer named Optimist mid-level leader
item.description: Braden Walmer, the son of Ted and Claire Walmer and an eighth-grader at Sauk Prairie Middle School, has been named the Sauk Prairie Optimist Middle Level Leader for January on Jan. 21.

item.title: Sauk Prairie Healthcare named to Forbes list
item.description: Sauk Prairie Healthcare has been named to the list of Forbes Top Hospitals for 2026, according to a Jan. 15 release. This is the first time Forbes has published such a list.

item.title: ER nurse receives DAISY Award
item.description: Sarah Elliott, RN, Emergency Room, has been named as the fourth quarter DAISY Award for Extraordinary Nurses winner at SSM Health St. Clare Hospital-Baraboo on Jan. 20.

item.title: How rural police and first responders are keeping their departments alive
item.description: Rural police, fire and EMS leaders sponsor training, push advantages to keep and recruit responders.

item.title: Madison College Celebrate A Nurse run returns May 2
item.description: Madison College Reedsburg’s Celebrate a Nurse 5K and 1-mile walk/run returns on May 2, giving community members a way to honor the nurses who care for us every day, and help train the next generation entering the field.
